title: OpenVerify supply-chain allowlist
description: C259.2: the reviewed exceptions to the per-push supply-chain gate and release.yml's image scans. The gate (infra/scripts/supply-chain.sh) refuses an expired entry and an entry whose expiry is more than 90 days after the day it runs, which JSON Schema cannot express.

id.description: The advisory or check id the scanner reports: a GHSA, CVE, OSV, PYSEC or GO id, a Trivy misconfiguration id (AVD-...) or a zizmor audit name.

package.description: The package the finding is in, as the scanner names it (npm, PyPI, Maven group:artifact, or an OS package).

path.description: The repository path the finding is in (a workflow, a Dockerfile, a chart template), relative to the root.

reason.description: Why the finding is accepted until the expiry: for example "no fix available" with what limits the exposure.

expires.description: The last day the entry holds (YYYY-MM-DD), at most 90 days after the day it is added; the gate refuses it after that day.

added-by.description: The agent or person who reviewed and added the entry.
